passes: The chapter sustains itself through ordinary institutional labor rather than plot escalation.
Luo Cheng's embarrassment is visible through what he tries to translate into resume evidence rather than through a trauma explanation.
Sun Jie has bounded authority and is visibly imperfect: the office itself has version errors, printing friction and competing requests.
The job posting becomes concrete through student conversations, forms, duty schedules, material review and interruptions.
The post-meeting resume revision gives the conversation a behavioral consequence without turning it into instant personal transformation.
The chapter ends on an ordinary printing problem, leaving application outcome open.
problems: Sun Jie is still too consistently quick and correct in the central conversation. Several replies feel author-shaped, especially '你想换一点', '你又来了', and the repeated ability to identify exactly where Luo is overclaiming.
Luo Cheng is slightly too good at converting embarrassment into humor. More silence and imperfect recovery would make status pain less charming.

A few narrator lines explain the scene more than needed, especially the paragraph about student affairs previously feeling like a complete thing and the explicit description of his old resume as dangerous after the conversation.
The scene contains many crisp mini-exchanges. Individually plausible, collectively they make both characters sound unusually responsive for a busy office.
The printing-shop section is useful but could lose several explicit comparisons between 'small' experience and the job language; the reader already understands the mismatch.
subtractive_revision_plan: Cut 10-20% of dialogue, especially lines that restate the same boundary in sharper wording.
Remove at least two narrator explanations of what the office or resume means to Luo.
Keep Sun Jie's template/version oversight visible so she remains a working person rather than a competence oracle.
Let one or two questions receive flat or incomplete answers instead of polished reframing.
Shorten the printing-shop reflection and keep the ordinary machine problem ending.
next_action: Produce ch03-luo-posting-full-v2.md by subtraction only, then compare v1/v2 before any prose canon decision.
